subject.title: Feature Request: Inline media display in chat (images, audio, video, web previews)

question: Should #64607 remain open as the canonical inline-media umbrella now that direct tool-result images are merged, or should maintainers close it in favor of narrower remaining issues?
rationale: Current main solves meaningful image and MEDIA attachment slices, but the remaining work crosses security boundaries and product policy that automation should not decide.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Use #64607 to track the overall Control UI inline-media policy while the narrower security-reviewed issues continue independently.

options.title: Close As Split
options.body: Close this umbrella and nominate #40945, #86894, #89591, and #87023 as the only canonical remaining work items.

options.title: Narrow To Web Previews
options.body: Retitle or re-scope this issue to only rich web previews after confirming image/audio/video slices are fully covered elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Use #64607 to track the overall Control UI inline-media policy while the narrower security-reviewed issues continue independently.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is the strongest current-main routing signal for the central Control UI rendering files in this checkout, with related slice owners available for focused follow-up.
